enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $81,000 for FM3 Research to survey 1,000 Oakland parents on school enrollment
enrichment.summary: The district hired FM3 Research to run an online and phone survey, in English, Spanish, Chinese and Arabic, of 1,000 Oakland parents. About 750 are parents of current or planned OUSD students and 250 have children who do not attend OUSD schools. FM3 will present its findings to the Student Assignment Department. The work runs April 15 to June 30, 2026, and the Board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
